name: University of Warwick
summary: A campus university on the edge of Coventry with about 200 courses; IB offers run from 34 to 39 points, and maths-heavy courses use the TMUA.

ib.text: Each course sets a total, from 34 (Ancient History) to 39 with 6,6,6 at HL including Maths AA (Mathematics). English A at SL or HL 4 meets English bands A–B; band C needs a 5.

dates.label: TMUA: booking for the October sitting closes, 18:00 UK time
TMUA: booking for the January sitting closes
UCAS equal consideration deadline, 18:00 UK time

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.about: Micro, macro and econometrics taught through research, from abstract models to empirical tests of markets, institutions and public policy. A flexible structure lets you take options inside or outside the department, including Business School, Politics, Philosophy and Computer Science modules.
programmes.ib: 38 points including 6 in HL Maths, either AA or AI.
programmes.selectionNote: The TMUA is optional; top scorers can get a reduced offer and applicants without it are still considered. No interview; the personal statement and reference are read.

flagshipSource.title: Economics BSc: research-led teaching in micro, macro and econometrics, with options across the university

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: An accredited degree built on principles rather than fashions: software engineering, algorithm analysis and system design, taught from first principles with no programming assumed. You complete an individual project in year three and can add a year in industry, research or abroad.
programmes.ib: 39 points with 7, 6, 6 at HL, including 7 in HL Maths Analysis and Approaches only.
programmes.selectionNote: The TMUA is required unless you qualify for a contextual offer; without it you may not be considered. No interview; the UCAS application is read.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science BSc: BCS-accredited, taught from first principles, with a year in industry or abroad option

programmes.name: Ancient History and Classical Archaeology
programmes.about: The history, art and archaeology of the ancient Mediterranean through texts, images and material remains. You handle real artefacts, can join fieldwork in Greece, visit sites and museums, and take part in an annual classical play staged at a professional theatre. An ancient language is optional.
programmes.ib: 34 points. No HL subject is named.
programmes.selectionNote: Warwick does not typically interview. Offers come from the UCAS application: predicted and achieved grades, personal statement and school reference.

flagshipSource.title: Ancient History and Classical Archaeology BA: hands-on artefacts, fieldwork and an annual classical play

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: Humanities degrees ask from 34 points (Ancient History and Classical Archaeology); no interview, and the personal statement is read.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science, Engineering and Medicine
faculties.line: Computer Science asks 39 with 7,6,6 and HL Maths AA 7, plus the TMUA; maths-heavy courses use the TMUA or STEP.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Sciences
faculties.line: Economics asks 38 with 6 in HL Maths (AA or AI); the TMUA is optional but can earn a reduced offer.

notes: Overseas fees are set in bands; 2027-28 fees were not yet set, and Economics (Band 2) cost £35,530 in 2026-27.
Computer Science needs the TMUA and Mathematics the TMUA or STEP; for Economics the TMUA is optional, and top scorers can get a reduced offer.
TMUA results count only in the application year you sit them, so a gap-year applicant must retake it.
